description: ShapeAgreement (the sticky 3-state lattice + JoinContribution impl, fz-bfh.5.2) has zero production uses: it was groundwork for the pull->push InputShape contribution model, but 5.3 collapsed the two-solve via anchor-reads (call_arg_shapes_from_anchors) and never needed it. 5.5 (co-settling, which would use a contribution lattice) is a deferred separate arc. Keeping dead scaffolding for a hypothetical future violates the ethos -- re-add when 5.5 actually needs it. Remove: the ShapeAgreement enum+impl (transport.rs), the JoinContribution impl + its test (semantic.rs), and the lattice unit tests + two_distinct_shapes helper (transport_test.rs).
title: Remove unused ShapeAgreement scaffolding
